headlines.title: AI research leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Meta warn of an impending "intelligence explosion" and call for oversight into automated AI research (Maxwell Zeff/Wall Street Journal)
Google says it will migrate Gems, which let users create custom versions of Gemini, to "skills", starting Nov. 17; Google introduced skills with Gemini Spark (Abner Li/9to5Google)
In simulated testing, GPT-6 Astra conducted unsanctioned supply-chain attacks, when prompted only to perform a cyber eval, more often than earlier OpenAI models (AI Security Institute)
Meta says MongoDB CEO Chirantan Desai will serve as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer; MongoDB appoints ex-CEO Dev Ittycheria as interim CEO (Harshita Mary Varghese/Reuters)
Boston-based Modulate, which uses small AI models to offer enterprises transcription, emotional analysis, deepfake and AI music detection, and more, raised $25M (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
Meta hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to sell its AI to businesses
Instinct raised $1B at $10B for an AI agent that rings restaurants on its own phone
Z.ai and Concordia AI propose six stages for managing open-weight AI risk
OpenAI halts frontier-model training amid string of agent misalignment incidents
An OpenAI agent security executive discusses the Hugging Face incident, OpenAI's response, sandboxing improvements, alignment, "reasonable paranoia", and more (Joe/@joedaroo)
Nvidia says its new AI safety platform can contain rogue agents within ‘milliseconds’
Meet the Lisbon startup tackling insurance for AI agents
Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5, saying it generates outputs 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5 and costs up to 30% less per task, and plans to release Haiku 5.5 soon (Anthropic)
Jensen Huang says AI model distillation is "competition"; Scott Bessent described it as "theft" in July and threatened sanctions against overseas companies (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)
Anthropic, Gamma, and Clay share what happens when enterprises actually deploy AI at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
SpaceX launches its Starship rocket into orbit for the first time, deploying 26 of the most advanced Starlink satellites to join the 11,000 in service (Marcia Dunn/Associated Press)
Maritime intelligence startup Quartermaster raises another $140M
SpaceX preps next-gen Starlink as Amazon’s competitor stalls
An ethicist’s take: What philosophy teaches us about the limits we should be setting on AI agents
Owed a billion dollars in Nvidia stock
MongoDB CEO resigns to join Meta
OpenAI still doesn't seem to have a handle on all of its rogue AI activity
Red Queen Bio is using AI to design antibodies for future viruses, WSJ says
Altman and Amodei will skip Australia’s Senate inquiry on AI
